brief: Weekly UBS sales and trading note listing five derivatives trade themes, not a single connected argument. Re-correlation across assets is cited as driving some of this week's sharpest equity moves, but VIX has already dropped back below 20 and contagion has stayed limited so far. UBS Research's 'AI Disappoints' downside scenario flags Gold, Rates and SPX as potential hedges. The desk favors owning European volatility, hedging downside through SX5E put-spreads; a formal MAR disclosure confirms a live 'Shorter Delta' (short) Eurostoxx 50 recommendation, up to six months, dated 10-Nov-2026. Preferred equity longs are NDX, KOSPI2 and Global Industrials, funded by selling XLY calls; a matching disclosure shows a live 'Longer Delta' (long) DJ Stoxx 600 Industrial Goods & Services recommendation, up to three months, same date. Separately, the desk favors long Yen versus short CHF to play a rebound, with NKY/JPY hybrids and AUD/CHF dual digitals as alternatives; a disclosure also shows a live 'Shorter Delta' (short) USDCHF recommendation, up to six months, same date.
